description: Bộ eval nhóm cho research chatbot: 14 case, gồm 7 single-turn và 7 multi-turn. Bộ này phủ lookup, fetch, papers, paper_text, paper_review, paper_compare, đồng thời kiểm tra wrong_tool, wrong_arg_value, unnecessary_tool, và out_of_scope.

cases.query: Đọc và review paper sau, tập trung vào methodology. Abstract: We present RAGBench, a benchmark for retrieval augmented generation evaluation. Method: The benchmark contains 1,200 QA pairs across multi-hop and single-hop tasks, with retrieval quality and groundedness labels. Results: The benchmark exposes brittle retrieval on long context inputs. Limitations: It is English only and does not cover multimodal evidence.

args.text: Abstract: We present RAGBench, a benchmark for retrieval augmented generation evaluation. Method: The benchmark contains 1,200 QA pairs across multi-hop and single-hop tasks, with retrieval quality and groundedness labels. Results: The benchmark exposes brittle retrieval on long context inputs. Limitations: It is English only and does not cover multimodal evidence.

metadata.what_it_tests: Người dùng đã đưa đủ paper text và yêu cầu review theo methodology → gọi paper_review với focus=methodology.

turns.content: Mình có một đoạn paper, hãy review phần limitations.

Abstract: We study whether smaller context windows improve grounded summarization. Method: We compare a sparse retriever, a dense retriever, and a reranker on 600 QA examples. Results: Dense retrieval improves answer faithfulness by 6.8 points. Limitations: The study only covers English benchmarks and omits human preference analysis.
Chỉ tập trung vào limitations thôi.
